- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Overestimates prices in the final 5–10 days of the forecast window, particularly when true values are rising sharply.
- Shows persistent lag in capturing the true peak of price movements — often peaks too late or too low.
- Tends to overreact to recent volatility, overshooting in the short term after a spike, then undercorrecting.
- Mean reversion bias: forecasts often revert to historical mean too quickly, missing sustained upward trends.
- Underestimates the magnitude of upward momentum in the final 10 days of the forecast window.
- Overestimates downward momentum in the first 5–10 days, especially when true values are rising.
- Sensitive to recent low prices — tends to forecast higher prices than true values when recent prices are near or below 70.00.
